data.name: Förvaltnings AB Helje
data.description: Essunga Plantskola (operated by Förvaltnings AB Helje) is a Swedish family-owned tree nursery founded in 1937 that installed a Biomacon C160-F pyrolysis boiler to produce EBC-certified biochar from wood chips. The biochar is used as a peat-replacement substrate in their own container-grown plants and sold in bulk bags; the nursery business is the primary activity while biochar is an adjacent climate-oriented addition.
